title: Just ok.
text: Just ok.. This is just ok. Would look better as a set. My problem is with size of base. It's massive and looks clunky, not elegant, as a result. Medium weight, they are no Baldwin's. Holds a normal, taper candle.

features: ENHANCES YOUR DÉCOR: Brings elegant yet relatable style to your home décor
BEAUTIFULLY DESIGNED: Elegant tapered shape and finish are sure to get noticed
SHIMMER & SHINE: Smooth brass finish creates a modern touch
ALLURING DECORATIVE PIECE: Set a candle in this 15-inch decorative candleholder to bring elevated elegance to your table setting
description: Scott Living is a reflection of our own personal style inspired by what we hold dear: home, family, and a commitment to quality. We believe luxury should be accessible to everyone. Our design philosophy blends heirloom industrial and modern aesthetics that allow us to focus on interesting materials, textures, finishes, and colors to create unique signature looks. This Savoy 15-inch Polished Brass Candleholder brings elegant yet relatable style to your décor, with its brass finish and tapered shape. Candle not included. Made of metal. Measures 4.40x4.40x15.20 inches
